Class CsvUtils.CsvGenericLine

public abstract class CsvUtils.CsvGenericLine

Known derived/implementing types:
CsvUtils.CsvHeaders, CsvUtils.CsvLine

Abstract base class providing shared functionality for CsvLine and CsvHeaders. Contains field storage, type-safe accessors, and line serialization.
